details: This package is an unofficial-scope redistribution of the baileys WhatsApp client library that silently subscribes the user's WhatsApp account to the author's channel. In src/Socket/index.js the socket factory defaults a newsletter JID to 120363430764800148@newsletter and, whenever a 'connection.update' event reports connection === 'open', starts a 10-second timer that calls sock.newsletterFollow('120363430764800148@newsletter') on the linked account, retrying up to three times at 20-second intervals. The behaviour only stops if the caller explicitly passes autoFollowNewsletters: false or a different newsletterAutoFollowId, so any bot built on the package's default configuration follows the channel without the operator's knowledge or consent. The package also hard-depends on a sibling package in the same unofficial scope (@xzvbailss/xzgateway), which is loaded for hash and crypto helpers, and declares an optional @xzvbailss/xz-protect add-on. Its preinstall hook (engine-requirements.js) only verifies Node >= 20.
